# Source discovery report — XR-40 power bank recall claim

## Headline finding
The recall is real; the cabin-ban clause attached to it is not. The earliest
traceable publication of the recall itself is newswire.example
(https://newswire.example/2026/07/04/xr-40-power-bank-recall, 2026-07-04
09:12 UTC), reporting a voluntary manufacturer recall of a single battery lot.

## Corroboration
cityledger.example carried the same recall 41 minutes later
(https://cityledger.example/business/xr40-recall, 2026-07-04 09:53 UTC),
sourced from its own regulator filing rather than from the wire — an
independent second domain.

## The added claim
The "airlines banning them from hand luggage effective immediately" wording
does not appear in either report. Its earliest traceable use is the debunk at
factcheck.example (https://factcheck.example/claims/xr40-cabin-ban,
2026-07-05), which traces it to a reshared post and finds no carrier notice
behind it.

## Limitations
Archive coverage of the first six hours is incomplete, so an earlier posting of
the cabin-ban wording cannot be excluded.
